name: recovery_key_scan
description: Locate key material a case can use and say where it is, not what it is: BitLocker 48-digit recovery passwords (ASCII and UTF-16LE text) by file, offset, length and a structure check; private-key headers by type (RSA, EC, DSA, OPENSSH, ENCRYPTED, PGP, plain, or 'other': the header's own text is never echoed) and offset; and the names key files and credential stores are saved under (a name is a lead, not a read of the file). No value, fragment, masked shape or digest of a value is ever in the answer or in the files it names, and a path component shaped like a recovery password (a file named after the key) or like any identifier or secret is withheld from every printed path. A heuristic locator, not a verdict: a value is found unless it is glued to more digits ("key_<value>" is found, "<value>7" is not); passes_structure_check means eight groups divisible by 11 (a plausible transcription), not that the value opens any volume; a file is read up to max_bytes_per_file (default 8 MiB, streamed) and coverage lists every file that failed, was skipped (links, special files, a top-level proc, sys or dev), was read only in part or was not started, with the bytes not read. The tool has its own clock (max_seconds, default 480, below the timeout of 600): at it, or on SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGHUP, it stops reading, finishes its pages, closes the values file and answers once with status partial, naming every file and directory it did not reach (exit 128 + the signal for a signal) (the scan looks for the dash that follows a group, so the limit is a bound on a large tree or slow media, not the usual case). Every answer carries status and status_basis. It is not OCR, does not unpack archives or containers and does not read key stores. SENSITIVE: it reaches secret material, so run it as a job with secret_output: true (the manifest makes every job that sets write_values one). write_values: true (refused outside a job, and in a job whose process lacks SECRET_OUTPUT=1) creates $OUT/recovery-passwords.jsonl, mode 0600, before it scans (a file or link already there is refused by name) and writes the values, and the real paths, to it and nowhere else; with nothing found it stays empty and the answer says written: 0. Withholding is by shape, measured on 2,000 random draws per shape planted in a member name or path (rates, not guarantees): hexadecimal ids of 16, 32 and 64, numbers of 10 digits or more, recovery passwords written with dashes, spaces, dots, underscores or no separator, AWS access key ids, password= and api_key: assignments, user-info, and 4x4 groups of capitals and digits joined by - or . : printed whole in 0 draws; random mixed-case letters and digits of 8, 12 or 40 characters 0 draws, of 9 about 1.4%, of 16 about 0.6%; random lowercase letters and digits of 8 about 7%, of 12 about 2.4%, of 16 about 0.4%; 24 random letters about 2%, a 16-character base32 id about 3.4%, four groups of four lowercase hexadecimal digits joined by underscores about 8%, a full-width id 0 draws. NOT recognised, by design: an identifier of 7 characters or fewer, a number of 9 digits or fewer, a lowercase-only run of up to 22 letters (it reads as a word), a secret of any other shape; a file whose secrets matter is read in a job run with secret_output: true. It also changes names that are not secrets: of the file names of a documents tree 6.9% have a part withheld (10-digit timestamps, UUIDs) and 0.6% of its directories, of an application tree 16% and 3.1% (a word with a digit inside, such as libmp3lame, is withheld in part).

path.description: A directory to walk, or a single file to sweep. Links and special files inside it are not followed or read, and are listed

max_bytes_per_file.description: How much of each file to read (default 8388608, at least 1024); reading is streamed, so a larger value costs time, not memory. A file larger than this is listed as partial with the bytes not read

limit.description: Findings, name hints and coverage exceptions shown inline (default 200 each); all of them are counted, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in pages.<list>.all_results

write_values.description: Write each recovery password found to $OUT/recovery-passwords.jsonl (default false). Refused unless the tool runs as a job run as secret output (the harness makes a job that sets this one; the tool checks SECRET_OUTPUT=1 in its environment); the file is created first and a file or link already there is refused; the answer never carries a value

max_seconds.description: The tool's own time limit in seconds (default 480, 1 to 540; the manifest's timeout is 600). At it the scan stops, writes what it has and names the files and directories it did not reach
